items.title: Bank Preferred Stocks Are Sending a Warning About Interest Rates
items.summary: Weakness in preferred shares from Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and other major banks suggests investors expect interest rates to remain elevated.

items.title: Bank of America Is Bullish on SK hynix Stock as the Memory Chip Market Stays Tight
items.summary: The company is benefiting from several trends at once: strong AI demand, limited memory supply, high demand, and more long-term deals with customers.

items.title: Bonds Just Posted Their Worst Decade Since the Great Depression — Is This the Buying Opportunity of a Generation?
items.summary: Long-duration Treasuries just endured a stretch of losses not seen since before World War II, and the wreckage has left a question hanging over every fixed-income portfolio: does historic pain signal the beginning of a historic opportunity?

items.title: Bank of America pledges support for veterans, first responders ahead of 25th anniversary of 9/11
items.summary: Bank of America is marking the 25th anniversary of 9/11 by pledging funds to the Tunnel to Towers Foundation, the National 9/11 Memorial and veteran housing programs.

items.title: New Study Reveals Strongest State Economies, Only 1 State Was Better Than Texas
items.summary: CNBC's 20th annual state business rankings handed the overall crown to Ohio for the first time ever, but in the critical economy sub-category it was a two-state race: North Carolina led the nation and Texas came in second, even as the Lone Star State carries more foreign investment than any other top-10 economy in the country.

items.title: BofA stays bullish on a cloud titan that is down 25%
items.summary: A $240 price target implies nearly 65% upside, but debt rating agencies warn a $42 billion cash drain looms ahead.

items.title: What's Powering Bank of America's Strong Capital Return Strategy?
items.summary: Strong earnings momentum, a solid capital cushion and ample buyback capacity are underpinning BAC's shareholder-return strategy.
